result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway completely lacking sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved grass or in the travel lanes, with no physical protection from high-speed vehicle traffic.

hazards.description: Complete absence of paved walkways forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on uneven grass surfaces.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane road lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, creating a high-risk environment for crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with narrow sidewalks on both sides, separated from the roadway by grass buffers. While basic pedestrian infrastructure exists, there is a complete lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures on this two-lane road.
